collar.anchor_and_continuation: At zero the canonical strip and HDC rectangle bound both disk counts by two. The two certified real F signs place two distinct zeros inside radius 8. Whole-boundary F clearance transports this count to each real time, and strict Rouche transfers each boundary count to Y. Each of F and Y also has two real bracket sign changes uniformly, strictly inside radius 8. Reciprocals and B/Y extend the two-circle bounds to the annulus.
